A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] battled [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in an attempt to destroy a [[Malevolence (II)|rebuilt version]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which had been [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destroyed]] earlier in the war.
